senses.gloss: अर्थ् vt. 10Ā (pp. अर्थित) 1. To request, to sue, to supplicate, to entreat, (with two accusatives, e.g. तमर्थये मोक्षम्) प्रहस्तमर्थयांचक्रे योद्धुम् Bt.xiv.88; 2. to strive to obtain, to wish.With अभि-, to beg, to request, to supplicate, इमं तावत्प्रियाप्रवृत्तये सारंगमासीनमभ्यर्थये Vikr.iv., or अवकाशं किलोदन्वान् रामायाभ्यर्थितो ददौ R.iv.58.With अभिप्र-, to request, to desire.With प्र-, 1. to desire, to wish for, to beg, to request, अवग्राहे यथा वृष्टिं प्रार्थयन्ते कृषीवलाः Bt.viii.48, R.vii.50; 2. to go in search of, to search, प्रार्थयध्वं तथा सीतां यात सुग्रीवशासनात् Bt.iii.48; 3. to attack, to fall upon, दुर्जयो लवणः शूलो विशूलः प्रार्थ्ययामिति R.xv.5, or तत्प्रार्थितं जवनवाजिगतेन राज्ञा R.ix.56.With प्रति-, 1. to make an enemy of; 2. to encounter, to meet with a hostile purpose, संख्ये प्रत्यर्थयत राघवम् Bt.vi.25 (here प्रत्यर्थयत is explained in another way also).With सम्-, 1. to consider, to believe, समर्थने वीर्यशृंगमिव भग्नमात्मनः R.xi.73; 2. to substantiate by proof, to corroborate.With संप्र-, to beg, to request, to supplicate, e.g. संप्रार्थयामास नगेन्द्रवर्यम्.

अर्थ m. 1. Object, purpose, e.g. ज्ञातार्थो ज्ञातसंबन्धः श्रोतुं श्रोता प्रवर्तते; (अर्थ is often used in this sense as the last member of adjectival compounds and may be rendered by ‘intended for,’ ‘for the sake of on account of’ &c., सन्तानार्थाय विधये R.i.84, ii.16, यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः Bg.iii.9. In ‘मशकार्थो धूमः’ and ‘आपदर्थे धनं रक्षेत्’ has the sense of “warding off” but it is derivable from the sense above given. The acc. dat. and loc. singulars of this word, viz., अर्थम्, अर्थाय and अर्थे often stand as last members of adverbial compounds in the above senses, वेलोपलक्षणार्थमादिष्टोऽस्मि भगवता काश्यपेन Sak.iv., तद्दर्शनाद्भूच्छम्भोर्भूयान् दारार्थमादरः K.S.vi.13.); 2. use, utility, profit, advantage; 3. motive, reason, ground (in these three senses, the word is generally used with the inst., e.g. को नु मे जीवितेनार्थः, नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन Bg.iii.18, अचेतनग्रहणेन नार्थः, सतामर्थः शिवार्चया, कोऽर्थस्तिरश्चां गुणैः Panch.ii.); 4. meaning, sense, signification, e.g. अर्थभेदेन शब्दभेदः; 5. anything expressed by words, तददोषै शब्दार्थौ सगुणौ K.Pr.i. (According to poeticians, this अर्थ is of three kinds, viz, वाच्य or primary (i.e. expressed), लक्ष्य or secondary, and व्यंग्य or suggested.); 6. money, wealth, riches, अजरामरवत्प्राज्ञो विद्यामर्थं च साधयेत्, अर्थानामर्जने दुःखम् Panch.i.; 7. interest, concern (as in स्वार्थ ‘one’s own interest’); 8. attainment of riches or worldly prosperity (considered as one of the four ends of worldly life (पुरुषार्थ), the other three being धर्म, काम and मोक्ष), अप्यर्थकामौ तस्यास्तां धर्म एव मनीषिणः R.i.25; 9. affair, matter, concern, इक्ष्वाकूणां दुरापेऽर्थे त्वदधीना हि सिद्धयः R.i.72, or अर्थोऽयमर्थान्तरभाव्य एव K.S.iii.18; 10. an object of sense, anything which can be perceived by any of the senses, इन्द्रियेभ्यः परा ह्यर्था अर्थेभ्यश्च परं मनः Katho., (the objects of sense are five in number, vix. शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस and गन्ध); 11. a request, a petition; 12. manner, kind; 13. an action, a plaint (in law).
आर्थ a. (f. र्थी) Relating to अर्थ q.v.
अर्थ-अधिकार m. charge of money, office of treasurer.
अर्थ-अन्तर n. 1. another matter, a new affair, अर्थोयमर्थान्तरभाव्य एव K.S.iii.18; 2. a different meaning (as in अर्थान्तरसंक्रमितवाच्य).

अर्थ-अन्तर˚न्यास m. a figure of speech (in rhetoric). It consists in the statement of a general proposition to support a particular one or of a particular instance to support a general proposition- (1) यावदर्थपदां वाचमेवमादाय माधवः । विरराम महीयांसः प्रकृत्या मितभाषिणः Sis.ii.13; (2) बृहत्सहायः कार्यान्तं क्षोदीयानपि गच्छति । सम्भूयांभोधिमन्येति महानद्या नगापगा ii.100.
अर्थ-अर्थिन् a. one who solicits wealth.
अर्थ-अलंकार m. a figure of speech dependent on sense and not on sound.
अर्थ-आगम m. income, acquisition of wealth.

अर्थ-आपत्ति f. 1. one of the five processes of inference of the Mīmānsākas; it is an inference by which any apparent inconsistency is explained away, e.g. पीनो देवदत्तो दिवा न भुंक्ते (where the inference of रात्रिभोजन explains the inconsistency); 2. (according to some writers on rhetoric) a figure of speech in which a relevant statement leads to an inference unconnected with the context or vice versa हारोऽयं हरिणाक्षीणां लुठति स्तनमण्डले । सक्तानामप्यववस्थेयं के वयं स्मरकिंकराः ॥ Am.S.100.
अर्थ-पति m. 1. lord of riches, a king, किञ्चिद्विहस्यार्थपतिं बभाषे R.ii.46, ix.3; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
अर्थ-उपार्जन n. acquisition of wealth.
अर्थ-उष्मन् m. the glow of wealth, the warmth of money, अर्थोष्मणा विरहितः पुरुषः स एव Bhartr.ii.40.
अर्थ-ओघ m. a treasure.
अर्थ-कर, -कृत् a. yielding wealth, useful.
अर्थ-कर, -कृत् a. yielding wealth, useful.
अर्थ-काम (I) m. du. wealth and pleasure, R.i.25.
अर्थ-काम (II) a. desirous of wealth.
अर्थ-कृच्छ्र n. 1. a difficulty, a difficult matter; 2. a pecuniary difficulty, e.g. न मुह्येदर्थकृच्छ्रेषु.
अर्थ-कृत्य n. execution of any business, अभ्युपेतार्थकृत्याः Megh.i.38.
अर्थ-गौरव m. depth of meaning, e.g. भारवेरर्थगौरवम्.
अर्थ-घ्न a. extravagant, wasteful.
अर्थ-जात (I) a. full of meaning.
अर्थ-जात (II) n. 1. a collection of things; 2. considerable wealth.
अर्थ-तत्व n. truth, the real nature or cause of anything.
अर्थ-तस् ind. 1. with reference to the meaning; 2. in fact, really; 3. for the sake of money, ऐश्वर्यादनपेतमीश्वरमयं लोकोऽर्थतः सेवते Mud.i.; 4. on account of.
अर्थ-तस्˚गौरवम् n. depth of meaning, यच्चार्थतो गौरवम् M.M.i.
अर्थ-द a. 1. advantageous, useful; 2. liberal.
अर्थ-दूषण n. 1. unjust seizure of property; 2. waste; 3. finding fault with the meaning of a passage.

अर्थ-दोष m. a literary blemish in regard to sense. (The faults of composition are classed under the heads of पददोष, पदांशदोष, वाक्यदोष and अर्थदोष; for an enumeration and explanation of these, see K.Pr.vii.).
अर्थ-निबन्धन a. contingent on wealth.
अर्थ-निश्चय m. determination, decision.
अर्थ-पर, -लुब्ध a. intent on gaining wealth, covetous.
अर्थ-पर, -लुब्ध a. intent on gaining wealth, covetous.
अर्थ-प्रकृति f. a source of the grand object in a drama. (They are five- (1) बीज; (2) बिन्दु; (3) पताका; (4) प्रकरी and (5) कार्य.)
अर्थ-प्रयोग m. usury.
अर्थ-बन्ध n. composition, text, stanza.
अर्थ-बुद्धि a. selfish.
अर्थ-बोध m. indication of the real meaning.
अर्थ-भेद n. difference of meaning, e.g. अर्थभेदेन शब्दभेदः.
अर्थ-मात्र n. wealth.
अर्थ-लाभ m. acquisition of wealth.
अर्थ-वत् a. 1. having meaning, अर्थवदधातुरप्रत्ययः Pan.; 2. serving some purpose, not useless; 3. significant, e.g. अर्थवान् खलु मे राजशब्दः.

अर्थ-वाद m. 1. an explanatory remark (it recommends a precept (विधि) by stating the good it brings on, by enumerating the evils that result from its omission, by setting up long practice &c.); 2. declaration of any purpose; 3. praise, अर्थवाद एषः । दोषं तु मे कञ्चित्कथय Ut.i.
अर्थ-विद् a. sagacious, wise.
अर्थ-वृद्धि f. accumulation of wealth.
अर्थ-विकल्प m. 1. deviation from truth; 2. prevarication.
अर्थ-व्यय m. expenditure.
अर्थ-शास्त्र n. 1. science of polity or moral and political government, अर्थशास्त्रकारास्त्रिविधां सिद्धिमामनन्ति Mud.iii.; 2. science of general conduct in life.
अर्थ-शौच n. honesty in money matters, सर्वेषामेव शौचानामर्थशौचं परं स्मृतम् M.v.106.
अर्थ-संस्थान n. treasury.
अर्थ-सम्बन्ध m. connection of sense with a word or a sentence.
अर्थ-सिद्धि f. fulfilment of desired object, success.
अर्थना f. Request, begging, entreaty, Na.v.112.
अर्थात् ind. 1. As a matter of course, in fact, मूषकेन दण्डो भक्षित इत्यनेन तत्सहचरितमपूपभक्षणमर्थादायातं भवति S.D.x.; 2. that is to say, namely.
अर्थिक m. 1. A watchman; 2. a minstrel whose business it is to announce the different hours of the day.
आर्थिक a. (f. की) 1. Significant; 2. rich; 3. wise.

अर्थिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. One who seeks for anything, (with the inst., e.g. भार्यया चार्थी); 2. desirous of, (with the inst., e.g. को वधेन ममार्थी स्यात्); 3. entreating anyone, (with the gen., e.g. अर्थी वररुचिर्मेस्तु.)

अर्थिन् (II) m. 1. A beggar, a suitor, कन्यारत्नमयोनिजन्म भवतामास्ते वयं चार्थिनः Mv.i., यथाकामार्चितार्थिनाम् R.i.6, ii.54, ix.27; 2. a prosecutor, a plaintiff, a complainant, स धर्मस्थसखः शश्वदर्थिप्रत्यर्थिनः स्वयम् । ददर्श संशयच्छेद्यान् व्यवहारानतन्द्रितः R.xvii.39; 3. a servant.

अर्थिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. One who seeks for anything, (with the inst., e.g. भार्यया चार्थी); 2. desirous of, (with the inst., e.g. को वधेन ममार्थी स्यात्); 3. entreating anyone, (with the gen., e.g. अर्थी वररुचिर्मेस्तु.)
अर्थिन्-सात् ind. at the disposal of beggars, (with कृ, e.g. विभज्य मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात्कृतः Na.i.16).
अर्थीय a. (f. या) Destined for, relating to (always used as the last member of a compound, कर्मचैव तदर्थीयम् Bg.xvii.27.)
अर्थीय a. (f. या) Destined for, relating to (always used as the last member of a compound, कर्मचैव तदर्थीयम् Bg.xvii.27.)
अर्थ्य (I) a. (f. र्थ्या) 1. Worthy of being sought; 2. appropriate, significant, स्तुत्यं स्तुतिभिरर्थ्याभिरूपतस्थे सरस्वती R.iv.6; 3. fit, proper; 4. wise.
अर्थ्य (II) n. Red chalk.
अर्थ्य (I) a. (f. र्थ्या) 1. Worthy of being sought; 2. appropriate, significant, स्तुत्यं स्तुतिभिरर्थ्याभिरूपतस्थे सरस्वती R.iv.6; 3. fit, proper; 4. wise.
आर्थ a. (f. र्थी) Relating to अर्थ q.v.
आर्थिक a. (f. की) 1. Significant; 2. rich; 3. wise.
